Subject: Marketplace listing initiation — need preflight on branding/claims/SLA

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are moving to finalize our AWS Marketplace listing and want a short preflight with Redwood to make sure our listing copy and SLAs align with marketplace policy and Redwood co-sell expectations. High-level asks:

- Quick review of branding assets (logo, product screenshots) for Marketplace guidelines; any resize/background rules?
- Claims language: we currently say "enterprise-ready" and "sub-millisecond inference" — we want to confirm what's acceptable and whether we need citation/benchmarks.
- Support SLA language and co-sell expectations: proposed 24/7 email + business-hours phone support; looking to understand Redwood's preferred phrasing and what co-sell ops will expect.

I've attached our brand guidelines and a first-pass listing copy. Can we set a 30-minute preflight with someone from product/legal and your marketplace lead today or tomorrow?

Attachments: ArchCloud-Brand-Guidelines.pdf (logo/colors), proposed_listing_copy.docx

Thanks,
Katie Sullivan
Head of Partnerships
ArchCloud

ArchCloud does not offer legal advice. This message may contain confidential information.

Katie — thanks for the doc drops. Looping Marissa (marketplace ops) and Vanessa (partner co-sell) so we can cover the three buckets. Proposed agenda for 30-min preflight:

1) Branding & images: required formats, transparent background rules, recommended screenshot crop sizes for AWS/GCP/Azure.
2) Claims review: concrete language we accept vs phrases that trigger request for evidence. If you claim "sub-millisecond" we need test harness notes or to qualify it for specific request sizes.
3) Support & SLAs: preferred wording for co-sell listings, minimal support channels for Marketplace listing, and how we surface response targets in collateral.
4) Co-sell ops checklist: co-sell enablement materials, case studies, sales enablement assets and PubSec/Compliance pointers if relevant.

Can you share: a short statement of how you measure the "sub-millisecond" number (test config), and whether phone support is outsourced or in-house?

We're free 2:00–2:30pm PT today or 10:00–10:30am PT tomorrow. Which works?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Marketplace
Redwood Inference

From: katie.sullivan <katie.sullivan@archcloud.com>

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing initiation — need preflight on branding/claims/SLA

Thanks Karthik — 2:00pm PT works for us. Quick answers inline below and attached an updated copy of the listing with SLA language.

> a short statement of how you measure the "sub-millisecond" number (test config)
We run inference on our optimized runtime (2x A100 equivalent) with fixed 64-token batches and report p99 token latency under a controlled emulation of a single-request stream. Happy to provide the test harness and raw numbers under NDA; for the listing we can qualify the claim to "p99 latency under our standard benchmark" unless Redwood prefers a different phrasing.

> whether phone support is outsourced or in-house
Phone support is in-house during business hours (EST 8am–6pm). After hours phone is on-call through our managed NOC partner (OpsLine). We can revise to "business-hours phone support with 24/7 email and on-call escalation" if that aligns better.

Attached: proposed_listing_copy.docx (v1.1 with SLA section), ArchCloud-Brand-Guidelines.pdf (updated).

See you at 2pm PT.

Cheers,
Katie
Katie Sullivan
Head of Partnerships, ArchCloud

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing initiation — need preflight on branding/claims/SLA (Redlines + next steps)

Katie, team — quick notes from today's preflight (pulled verbatim into a short review doc; attached). Top-line items and required edits before we submit to AWS Marketplace ops: 

- Branding: logo OK but needs a clear/transparent PNG (no white box). Product screenshots must be at least 1024x576 and anonymize any customer PII. No gradient overlays on hero image.
- Claims language: "sub-millisecond inference" is actionable and will trigger marketplace evidence requests. Recommend change to: "p99 latency under ArchCloud standard benchmark (test config available on request)". If you want the stronger claim, we need a short benchmark summary and a runbook for reproducibility.
- Support / SLA: Marketplace listing should not promise a contractual SLA unless you have a signed contract attached. For listing copy use: "business-hours phone support, 24/7 email support, and on-call escalation". If you want a formal SLA entry in the listing, attach the signed SLA doc and legal contact.
- Co-sell collateral: please prepare one 2-page datasheet and one customer success snapshot (no PII). We can include these in the co-sell pack.

Next steps:
1) ArchCloud to update listing copy per redlines and provide transparent PNG of logo and one sanitized screenshot (by EOD 5/22).
2) If ArchCloud wants the stronger latency claim, deliver benchmark summary and agree NDA for sharing raw runs.
3) Redwood to route final copy to aws-mktplace-ops@amazon.com and start co-sell enablement once listing is live.

Attached: review_notes.pdf (detailed redlines).

I'll open a tracker (internal) and loop Marketplace Ops for the actual submission. Vanessa — can you capture the co-sell enablement tasks in the playbook?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
